result.summary: The home screen is mostly well laid out. One clear defect: the Smash Bros Burgers card shows a broken delivery fee ('€NaN delivery'), which is a data/formatting bug. There is also a minor consistency issue in the delivery-time badge overlays.

issues.description: The Smash Bros Burgers card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery fee. This is a data or formatting error that exposes a raw code value to users.
issues.suggestion: Fix the fee calculation or formatting so a valid price is always shown. If the fee is missing, show a fallback such as 'Delivery fee unavailable' or hide the fee, and validate numeric values before rendering.

issues.description: The delivery-time pill on the first carousel card ('15–25 min') slightly overlaps the plate illustration. It sits close to the bottom-left edge and looks cramped against the image compared with the other cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the badge position and padding across cards, and keep the badge from covering the key part of the image.
